ValidationRule.description: Exige SM_Payment_day__c antes de cambiar el Status de un contrato que requiere pago RC. Ver VR016_RCStartDateRequired para el contexto (2026-09-17).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Contract_Type__c , 'Dependent')), ISCHANGED(Status), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Draft'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Finalized'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Cancelled') ) ), NOT(Is_Test_Contract__c), NOT(Is_VIP_Contract__c), NOT(SM_Full_Payment__c), NOT(SM_Customer_Cancellation__c), SM_Billing_status__c <> 'PAYMENT COMPLETED', ISBLANK(CB_Subscription__c), SM_Requires_RC_Payment__c = true, ISBLANK(TEXT(SM_Payment_day__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: SM_Payment_day__c (Dia de Pago de RC) es obligatorio antes de cambiar el Status de un contrato que requiere pago RC.
